about: cargo check of verbatim-model from an empty target folder, offline: about a hundred "Checking" and "Compiling" lines flooding past while cargo's progress bar is redrawn on the row below them, and its last line.
command: cmd.exe /c "(if exist targetecording-cargo rmdir /s /q targetecording-cargo) & cargo check -p verbatim-model --offline --target-dir targetecording-cargo & rmdir /s /q targetecording-cargo"
